```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# FIGURE 3 — GENE DISTANCE + GENOME-WIDE DISTRIBUTION
# Reconstructed from the ORIGINAL analysis used for the manuscript slides.
#
# IMPORTANT:
#   * No Figure 3 percentages are hard-coded.
#   * Individual-TE concordance/discordance uses the original
#     MUTUAL UNIQUE LARGEST OVERLAP definition.
#   * Setaria uses the original Setaria_full_sequence_silix.out and
#     Setaria_five_prime_silix.out files and the original composite TE key.
#   * Panel A is recalculated from TE coordinates + gene annotations.
#   * Panel B uses 1-Mb windows; Maize displays Chr1–Chr10 and Setaria Chr1–Chr9.
# ==============================================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(stringr)
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(IRanges)
  library(S4Vectors)
  library(patchwork)
})

# ==============================================================================
# 1. SETTINGS
# ==============================================================================

output_dir <- "final_panel_figures"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

b73_full_path <- paste0(
  "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/",
  "family_analysis/redo_full_sequence/B73/output/",
  "B73_full_sequence_silix.out"
)

b73_five_path <- paste0(
  "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/",
  "family_analysis/redo_five_prime/B73/output/",
  "B73_five_prime_silix.out"
)

# These are the Setaria files used in the original individual-TE analysis.
setaria_full_path <- paste0(
  "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/",
  "family_analysis/redo_full_sequence/Setaria/",
  "Setaria_full_sequence_silix.out"
)

setaria_five_path <- paste0(
  "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/",
  "family_analysis/redo_five_prime/Setaria/",
  "Setaria_five_prime_silix.out"
)

b73_gene_gff <- paste0(
  "/projects/standard/hirschc1/menar060/",
  "programs/input_data/maize/",
  "B73v5_genes.gff3"
)

setaria_gtf_path <- file.path(
  "/projects/standard/hirschc1/shared/projects/Setaria_TEs/andyTEs",
  "SvMEV034.gtf"
)

required_files <- c(
  b73_full_path,
  b73_five_path,
  setaria_full_path,
  setaria_five_path,
  b73_gene_gff,
  setaria_gtf_path
)

missing_files <- required_files[!file.exists(required_files)]
if (length(missing_files) > 0) {
  stop(
    "The following required files were not found:\n",
    paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n")
  )
}

# ==============================================================================
# 2. COLORS / THEME
# ==============================================================================

divergent_palette <- c(
  "#27408B", "#1B9E77", "#2AA198", "#56B4E9",
  "#E6AB02", "#D55E6A", "#984EA3", "#7F1D3A"
)

status_colors <- c(
  "Clustering concordance" = divergent_palette[1],
  "Clustering discordance" = divergent_palette[8]
)

publication_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 3. ORIGINAL SILIX ATTRIBUTE HELPERS
# ==============================================================================

extract_silix_attribute <- function(attribute_string, attribute_name) {
  attribute_string <- as.character(attribute_string)
  pattern <- paste0("(?:^|;)", attribute_name, "=([^;]+)")
  extracted_value <- sub(
    paste0(".*", pattern, ".*"),
    "\\1",
    attribute_string,
    perl = TRUE
  )
  no_match <- !grepl(pattern, attribute_string, perl = TRUE)
  extracted_value[no_match] <- NA_character_
  extracted_value
}

extract_silix_chromosome <- function(attribute_string) {
  result <- sub(
    ".*::([^:]+):[0-9]+-[0-9]+\\([^)]*\\)$",
    "\\1",
    as.character(attribute_string),
    perl = TRUE
  )
  matched <- grepl(
    "::[^:]+:[0-9]+-[0-9]+\\([^)]*\\)$",
    as.character(attribute_string),
    perl = TRUE
  )
  result[!matched] <- NA_character_
  result
}

extract_silix_start <- function(attribute_string) {
  result <- sub(
    ".*::[^:]+:([0-9]+)-[0-9]+\\([^)]*\\)$",
    "\\1",
    as.character(attribute_string),
    perl = TRUE
  )
  matched <- grepl(
    "::[^:]+:[0-9]+-[0-9]+\\([^)]*\\)$",
    as.character(attribute_string),
    perl = TRUE
  )
  result[!matched] <- NA_character_
  suppressWarnings(as.integer(result))
}

extract_silix_end <- function(attribute_string) {
  result <- sub(
    ".*::[^:]+:[0-9]+-([0-9]+)\\([^)]*\\)$",
    "\\1",
    as.character(attribute_string),
    perl = TRUE
  )
  matched <- grepl(
    "::[^:]+:[0-9]+-[0-9]+\\([^)]*\\)$",
    as.character(attribute_string),
    perl = TRUE
  )
  result[!matched] <- NA_character_
  suppressWarnings(as.integer(result))
}

# ==============================================================================
# 4. READ ORIGINAL FOUR SILIX FILES
# ==============================================================================

read_silix <- function(path) {
  data.table::fread(
    path,
    header = FALSE,
    sep = "\t",
    select = 1:2,
    col.names = c("Family_ID", "Element_Attributes")
  )
}

b73_full_dt <- read_silix(b73_full_path)
b73_five_dt <- read_silix(b73_five_path)
setaria_full_dt <- read_silix(setaria_full_path)
setaria_five_dt <- read_silix(setaria_five_path)

# ==============================================================================
# 5. BUILD B73 ASSIGNMENTS EXACTLY AS IN ORIGINAL ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

b73_full_assignments <- b73_full_dt %>%
  mutate(
    TE_ID = extract_silix_attribute(Element_Attributes, "ID"),
    TE_Name = extract_silix_attribute(Element_Attributes, "Name"),
    Parent_ID = extract_silix_attribute(Element_Attributes, "Parent"),
    Chromosome = extract_silix_chromosome(Element_Attributes),
    TE_Start = extract_silix_start(Element_Attributes),
    TE_End = extract_silix_end(Element_Attributes),
    Full_Seq_Family = paste0("B73_Full_", Family_ID)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(TE_ID), grepl("^LTRRT_", TE_ID)) %>%
  select(
    TE_ID, TE_Name, Parent_ID, Chromosome,
    TE_Start, TE_End, Full_Seq_Family
  ) %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

b73_five_assignments <- b73_five_dt %>%
  mutate(
    Five_Prime_LTR_ID = extract_silix_attribute(Element_Attributes, "ID"),
    TE_ID = sub("^lLTR_", "LTRRT_", Five_Prime_LTR_ID),
    Five_Prime_Family = paste0("B73_5prime_", Family_ID)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Five_Prime_LTR_ID), grepl("^lLTR_", Five_Prime_LTR_ID)) %>%
  select(TE_ID, Five_Prime_LTR_ID, Five_Prime_Family) %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

b73_te_assignments <- b73_full_assignments %>%
  inner_join(b73_five_assignments, by = "TE_ID") %>%
  mutate(Species = "B73") %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 6. BUILD SETARIA ASSIGNMENTS EXACTLY AS IN ORIGINAL ANALYSIS
#
# Setaria raw IDs can be reused, so the original analysis used a composite key:
# normalized TE ID + Parent + Chromosome.
# ==============================================================================

setaria_full_assignments <- setaria_full_dt %>%
  mutate(
    Raw_TE_ID = extract_silix_attribute(Element_Attributes, "ID"),
    Parent_ID = extract_silix_attribute(Element_Attributes, "Parent"),
    TE_Name = extract_silix_attribute(Element_Attributes, "Name"),
    Chromosome = extract_silix_chromosome(Element_Attributes),
    TE_Start = extract_silix_start(Element_Attributes),
    TE_End = extract_silix_end(Element_Attributes),
    Normalized_TE_ID = sub("^LTRRT_", "", Raw_TE_ID),
    Full_Seq_Family = paste0("Setaria_Full_", Family_ID),
    TE_ID = paste(Normalized_TE_ID, Parent_ID, Chromosome, sep = "::")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Raw_TE_ID), !is.na(Parent_ID), !is.na(Chromosome)) %>%
  select(
    TE_ID, Normalized_TE_ID, Raw_TE_ID, TE_Name, Parent_ID,
    Chromosome, TE_Start, TE_End, Full_Seq_Family
  ) %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

setaria_five_assignments <- setaria_five_dt %>%
  mutate(
    Five_Prime_LTR_ID = extract_silix_attribute(Element_Attributes, "ID"),
    Parent_ID = extract_silix_attribute(Element_Attributes, "Parent"),
    Chromosome = extract_silix_chromosome(Element_Attributes),
    Normalized_TE_ID = sub("^lLTR_", "", Five_Prime_LTR_ID),
    Five_Prime_Family = paste0("Setaria_5prime_", Family_ID),
    TE_ID = paste(Normalized_TE_ID, Parent_ID, Chromosome, sep = "::")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Five_Prime_LTR_ID),
    grepl("^lLTR_", Five_Prime_LTR_ID),
    !is.na(Parent_ID),
    !is.na(Chromosome)
  ) %>%
  select(
    TE_ID, Normalized_TE_ID, Five_Prime_LTR_ID,
    Parent_ID, Chromosome, Five_Prime_Family
  ) %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

setaria_te_assignments <- setaria_full_assignments %>%
  inner_join(
    setaria_five_assignments %>%
      select(TE_ID, Five_Prime_LTR_ID, Five_Prime_Family),
    by = "TE_ID"
  ) %>%
  mutate(Species = "Setaria") %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ==============================================================================
# 7. ORIGINAL INDIVIDUAL-TE CONCORDANCE/DISCORDANCE FUNCTION
#
# This is NOT strict one-to-one family matching.
# A TE is concordant when its full × 5' pair is the unique largest overlap in
# BOTH clustering directions. Ties/minority overlaps are discordant.
# ==============================================================================

classify_individual_te_status <- function(assignment_df, species_name) {

  clean_assignments <- assignment_df %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(TE_ID),
      !is.na(Full_Seq_Family),
      !is.na(Five_Prime_Family)
    ) %>%
    distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

  pair_counts <- clean_assignments %>%
    count(Full_Seq_Family, Five_Prime_Family, name = "Pair_Size")

  pair_classification <- pair_counts %>%
    group_by(Full_Seq_Family) %>%
    mutate(
      Largest_Pair_in_Full = max(Pair_Size),
      Number_Tied_for_Full_Max = sum(Pair_Size == Largest_Pair_in_Full),
      Unique_Full_Maximum =
        Pair_Size == Largest_Pair_in_Full & Number_Tied_for_Full_Max == 1
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    group_by(Five_Prime_Family) %>%
    mutate(
      Largest_Pair_in_Five = max(Pair_Size),
      Number_Tied_for_Five_Max = sum(Pair_Size == Largest_Pair_in_Five),
      Unique_Five_Maximum =
        Pair_Size == Largest_Pair_in_Five & Number_Tied_for_Five_Max == 1
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      Mutual_Unique_Largest = Unique_Full_Maximum & Unique_Five_Maximum,
      Clustering_Status = if_else(
        Mutual_Unique_Largest,
        "Clustering concordance",
        "Clustering discordance"
      )
    )

  clean_assignments %>%
    left_join(
      pair_classification,
      by = c("Full_Seq_Family", "Five_Prime_Family")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Species = species_name,
      Clustering_Status = factor(
        Clustering_Status,
        levels = c("Clustering concordance", "Clustering discordance")
      )
    )
}

b73_individual_te_status <- classify_individual_te_status(
  b73_te_assignments, "B73"
)

setaria_individual_te_status <- classify_individual_te_status(
  setaria_te_assignments, "Setaria"
)

cat("\nINDIVIDUAL-TE STATUS COUNTS\n")
print(
  bind_rows(
    b73_individual_te_status %>% select(Species, TE_ID, Clustering_Status),
    setaria_individual_te_status %>% select(Species, TE_ID, Clustering_Status)
  ) %>%
    distinct(Species, TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    count(Species, Clustering_Status),
  n = Inf
)

# ==============================================================================
# 8. B73 DISTANCE TO NEAREST GENE — ORIGINAL ANALYSIS
# ==============================================================================

b73_gene_table <- data.table::fread(
  b73_gene_gff,
  header = FALSE,
  sep = "\t",
  quote = "",
  fill = TRUE,
  comment.char = "#",
  col.names = c(
    "seqid", "source", "type", "start", "end",
    "score", "strand", "phase", "attributes"
  )
)

b73_genes <- b73_gene_table %>%
  filter(type == "gene", !is.na(start), !is.na(end)) %>%
  transmute(
    Chromosome = as.character(seqid),
    Gene_Start = as.integer(start),
    Gene_End = as.integer(end),
    Gene_ID = coalesce(
      extract_silix_attribute(attributes, "ID"),
      extract_silix_attribute(attributes, "Name")
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(Chromosome, Gene_Start, Gene_End, .keep_all = TRUE)

b73_distance_input <- b73_individual_te_status %>%
  select(TE_ID, Clustering_Status) %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  inner_join(
    b73_te_assignments %>%
      select(TE_ID, Chromosome, TE_Start, TE_End) %>%
      distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "TE_ID"
  )

shared_b73_chr <- intersect(
  unique(b73_distance_input$Chromosome),
  unique(b73_genes$Chromosome)
)

b73_distance_input <- b73_distance_input %>%
  filter(Chromosome %in% shared_b73_chr)
b73_genes <- b73_genes %>%
  filter(Chromosome %in% shared_b73_chr)

b73_te_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = b73_distance_input$Chromosome,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = b73_distance_input$TE_Start,
    end = b73_distance_input$TE_End
  ),
  TE_ID = b73_distance_input$TE_ID,
  Clustering_Status = as.character(b73_distance_input$Clustering_Status)
)

b73_gene_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = b73_genes$Chromosome,
  ranges = IRanges(start = b73_genes$Gene_Start, end = b73_genes$Gene_End),
  Gene_ID = b73_genes$Gene_ID
)

b73_nearest <- distanceToNearest(
  b73_te_gr,
  b73_gene_gr,
  ignore.strand = TRUE
)

b73_te_gene_distance <- tibble(
  TE_Index = queryHits(b73_nearest),
  Gene_Index = subjectHits(b73_nearest),
  Distance_to_Nearest_Gene = mcols(b73_nearest)$distance
) %>%
  mutate(
    TE_ID = mcols(b73_te_gr)$TE_ID[TE_Index],
    Clustering_Status = mcols(b73_te_gr)$Clustering_Status[TE_Index],
    Nearest_Gene = mcols(b73_gene_gr)$Gene_ID[Gene_Index],
    Species = "B73"
  ) %>%
  select(
    TE_ID, Species, Clustering_Status,
    Nearest_Gene, Distance_to_Nearest_Gene
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 9. SETARIA DISTANCE TO NEAREST GENE — ORIGINAL ANALYSIS
#
# The original analysis collapsed transcript isoforms to one interval per gene.
# ==============================================================================

setaria_gtf <- data.table::fread(
  setaria_gtf_path,
  sep = "\t",
  header = FALSE,
  quote = "",
  fill = TRUE,
  comment.char = "#",
  col.names = c(
    "Chr", "Source", "Feature", "Start", "End",
    "Score", "Strand", "Frame", "Attributes"
  )
)

setaria_genes <- setaria_gtf %>%
  filter(Feature == "transcript") %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_ID_Raw = stringr::str_match(
      Attributes,
      'gene_id "([^"]+)"'
    )[, 2],
    Gene_ID = sub("-mRNA-.*$", "", Gene_ID_Raw)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gene_ID)) %>%
  group_by(Chr, Gene_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    Start = min(Start, na.rm = TRUE),
    End = max(End, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Use the SAME Setaria TE coordinates that were carried through the original
# full-sequence assignment table. This preserves the composite individual-TE key.
setaria_distance_input <- setaria_individual_te_status %>%
  select(TE_ID, Clustering_Status) %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  inner_join(
    setaria_te_assignments %>%
      select(TE_ID, Chromosome, TE_Start, TE_End) %>%
      distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "TE_ID"
  )

shared_setaria_chr <- intersect(
  unique(setaria_distance_input$Chromosome),
  unique(setaria_genes$Chr)
)

setaria_distance_input <- setaria_distance_input %>%
  filter(Chromosome %in% shared_setaria_chr)
setaria_genes <- setaria_genes %>%
  filter(Chr %in% shared_setaria_chr)

setaria_te_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = setaria_distance_input$Chromosome,
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = setaria_distance_input$TE_Start,
    end = setaria_distance_input$TE_End
  ),
  TE_ID = setaria_distance_input$TE_ID,
  Clustering_Status = as.character(setaria_distance_input$Clustering_Status)
)

setaria_gene_gr <- GRanges(
  seqnames = setaria_genes$Chr,
  ranges = IRanges(start = setaria_genes$Start, end = setaria_genes$End),
  Gene_ID = setaria_genes$Gene_ID
)

setaria_nearest <- distanceToNearest(
  setaria_te_gr,
  setaria_gene_gr,
  ignore.strand = TRUE
)

setaria_te_gene_distance <- tibble(
  TE_Index = queryHits(setaria_nearest),
  Gene_Index = subjectHits(setaria_nearest),
  Distance_to_Nearest_Gene = mcols(setaria_nearest)$distance
) %>%
  mutate(
    TE_ID = mcols(setaria_te_gr)$TE_ID[TE_Index],
    Clustering_Status = mcols(setaria_te_gr)$Clustering_Status[TE_Index],
    Nearest_Gene = mcols(setaria_gene_gr)$Gene_ID[Gene_Index],
    Species = "Setaria"
  ) %>%
  select(
    TE_ID, Species, Clustering_Status,
    Nearest_Gene, Distance_to_Nearest_Gene
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 10. PANEL A — DISTANCE WINDOWS
# ALL VALUES BELOW ARE CALCULATED, NOT HARD-CODED.
# ==============================================================================

gene_distance_all <- bind_rows(
  b73_te_gene_distance,
  setaria_te_gene_distance
) %>%
  mutate(
    Gene_Distance_Window = case_when(
      Distance_to_Nearest_Gene == 0 ~ "Inside gene",
      Distance_to_Nearest_Gene <= 1000 ~ "0–1 kb",
      Distance_to_Nearest_Gene <= 5000 ~ "1–5 kb",
      Distance_to_Nearest_Gene <= 10000 ~ "5–10 kb",
      Distance_to_Nearest_Gene > 10000 ~ ">10 kb",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Gene_Distance_Window = factor(
      Gene_Distance_Window,
      levels = c("Inside gene", "0–1 kb", "1–5 kb", "5–10 kb", ">10 kb")
    ),
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("B73", "Setaria")),
    Clustering_Status = factor(
      Clustering_Status,
      levels = c("Clustering concordance", "Clustering discordance")
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Gene_Distance_Window), !is.na(Clustering_Status))

gene_window_summary <- gene_distance_all %>%
  count(
    Species,
    Clustering_Status,
    Gene_Distance_Window,
    name = "Number_of_TEs",
    .drop = FALSE
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species, Clustering_Status) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_TEs = sum(Number_of_TEs),
    Proportion_of_TEs = Number_of_TEs / Total_TEs,
    Percent_Label = scales::percent(Proportion_of_TEs, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("\nPANEL A — CALCULATED GENE-DISTANCE VALUES\n")
print(gene_window_summary, n = Inf, width = Inf)

cat("\nCHECK — each Species × Status group should sum to 1:\n")
print(
  gene_window_summary %>%
    group_by(Species, Clustering_Status) %>%
    summarise(Sum = sum(Proportion_of_TEs), .groups = "drop"),
  n = Inf
)

pA <- ggplot(
  gene_window_summary,
  aes(
    x = Gene_Distance_Window,
    y = Proportion_of_TEs,
    fill = Clustering_Status
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.78),
    width = 0.70,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Species,
    nrow = 1,
    labeller = as_labeller(c("B73" = "Maize", "Setaria" = "Setaria"))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = status_colors, name = NULL, drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Distance to nearest gene",
    y = "Proportion of individual TEs"
  ) +
  publication_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 8.5,
      angle = 35,
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 1
    )
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 11. PANEL B — GENOME-WIDE DISCORDANT PROPORTION IN 1-Mb WINDOWS
#
# Uses the SAME individual-TE status objects as Panel A.
# Maize contains Chr1–Chr10; Setaria contains Chr1–Chr9.
# Chr1–Chr9 use the same ordering in both facets, with Chr10 added only to Maize.
# ==============================================================================

b73_genome_df <- b73_individual_te_status %>%
  select(TE_ID, Clustering_Status) %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  inner_join(
    b73_te_assignments %>%
      select(TE_ID, Chromosome, TE_Start, TE_End) %>%
      distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "TE_ID"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Species = "B73",
    TE_ID,
    Chr = Chromosome,
    Start = TE_Start,
    End = TE_End,
    Clustering_Status
  )

setaria_genome_df <- setaria_individual_te_status %>%
  select(TE_ID, Clustering_Status) %>%
  distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  inner_join(
    setaria_te_assignments %>%
      select(TE_ID, Chromosome, TE_Start, TE_End) %>%
      distinct(TE_ID, .keep_all = TRUE),
    by = "TE_ID"
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Species = "Setaria",
    TE_ID,
    Chr = Chromosome,
    Start = TE_Start,
    End = TE_End,
    Clustering_Status
  )

genome_te_df <- bind_rows(b73_genome_df, setaria_genome_df) %>%
  mutate(
    Chr_Number = suppressWarnings(as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", Chr))),
    Midpoint = floor((Start + End) / 2),
    Discordant = as.integer(Clustering_Status == "Clustering discordance")
  ) %>%
  # Keep all 10 maize chromosomes and the 9 Setaria chromosomes.
  filter(
    (Species == "B73" & Chr_Number %in% 1:10) |
    (Species == "Setaria" & Chr_Number %in% 1:9)
  )

window_size <- 1000000L

window_summary <- genome_te_df %>%
  mutate(
    Window_Number = floor((Midpoint - 1) / window_size) + 1,
    Window_Start = (Window_Number - 1) * window_size + 1
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species, Chr_Number, Window_Number, Window_Start) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_TEs = n(),
    Discordant_TEs = sum(Discordant),
    Discordant_Proportion = Discordant_TEs / Total_TEs,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("B73", "Setaria")),
    Chr_Display = factor(
      paste0("Chr", Chr_Number),
      levels = paste0("Chr", 10:1)
    )
  )

cat("\nPANEL B — CHROMOSOMES RETAINED\n")
print(
  genome_te_df %>%
    distinct(Species, Chr_Number) %>%
    arrange(Species, Chr_Number),
  n = Inf
)

pB <- ggplot(
  window_summary,
  aes(
    x = Window_Start,
    y = Chr_Display,
    fill = Discordant_Proportion
  )
) +
  geom_tile(width = window_size, height = 0.88) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~Species,
    nrow = 1,
    scales = "free",
    labeller = as_labeller(c("B73" = "Maize", "Setaria" = "Setaria"))
  ) +
  # With free facet scales and drop = TRUE, Chr10 appears only for Maize.
  # Chr1–Chr9 remain identically ordered in both species.
  scale_y_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c(
      "white",
      "#F2D9DE",
      "#D9A5B0",
      "#B96578",
      divergent_palette[8]
    ),
    values = scales::rescale(c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1)),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = c(0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1),
    labels = label_percent(accuracy = 1),
    name = "Discordant\nTE proportion"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = function(x) paste0(x / 1e6, " Mb"),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Genomic position",
    y = "Chromosome"
  ) +
  publication_theme +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1.2, "lines")
  )

# ==============================================================================
# 12. COMBINE + SAVE
# ==============================================================================

figure3 <- pA / pB +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1.15)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))

print(figure3)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "Figure3_full_panel_ORIGINAL_ANALYSIS.jpeg"),
  figure3,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 6.4,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  file.path(output_dir, "Figure3_full_panel_ORIGINAL_ANALYSIS.pdf"),
  figure3,
  width = 7.2,
  height = 6.4,
  units = "in",
  bg = "white"
)

write.table(
  gene_window_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "Figure3_gene_distance_summary.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.table(
  window_summary,
  file.path(output_dir, "Figure3_1Mb_discordant_windows.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

cat(
  "\nDone. Figure 3 values were calculated from the original analysis pipeline.\n",
  "No Panel A percentages were hard-coded.\n"
)
```
